paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhmai, Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar, and Rabbi Chanina—bar Chama; Shabbat 49a, end, has Akhnai—lived in Rabbi’s time. In Rif: Rabbi Yochanan ben Akhmai, Rabbi Yochanan ben Elazar, and Rabbi Chanina ben Abba. Rabbi Abbahu said: ‘Yonatan ben Akhmai taught me’: Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot, end of chapter 11, and Bammeh Madlikin, halakhah 1. He was a great man, well versed in our Mishnah. Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai sent his son to him and to Rabbi Yehudah ben Gerim—see his entry—to receive their blessing. This requires examination, for Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai preceded Rabbi Chanina bar Chama and Rabbi Abbahu by much. And Rabbi Shimon ben Zerud: one was ordained and one was not; see Rav Shemen bar Abba. In Yevamot 15b there is a great Jerusalem family of the House of Akhmai.
